name: MCLEAN
recent: MClean 于 2026 年 11 月完成 2400 万股私募配售，每股 RM0.60，并在 ACE Market 上市。同期，公司披露 M&C Precision 提起传票诉讼的重大诉讼事项。此前，大股东 Accrelist Crowdfunding 于 10 月在场外脱售 3000 万股。
notable: 完成私募配售，发行 2400 万股新股，每股 RM0.60，于 2026 年 11 月 11 日上市。
M&C Precision 提起传票诉讼，公司披露为重大诉讼。
大股东 Accrelist Crowdfunding 于 2026 年 10 月 20 日场外脱售 3000 万股（12.184%）。
risks: 私募配售发行新股，占已发行股份最多 10%，可能摊薄现有股东权益。
公司面临 M&C Precision 提起的诉讼。
大股东在公开市场外脱售大量股份。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 MYR 20.117 million，环比增长 8.9%，同比增长 14.2%；净利为 MYR 3.859 million，环比增长 21.1%，同比增长 36.3%；净利率为 19.2%，高于上一季度的 17.3%。

recent_en: MClean completed a private placement of 24 million shares at RM0.60 per share, listed on the ACE Market in November 2026. In the same period, the company disclosed a material litigation involving a writ of summons filed by M&C Precision. Earlier, substantial shareholder Accrelist Crowdfunding disposed of 30 million shares off-market in October.
notable_en: Completed private placement of 24 million new shares at RM0.60 each, listed on 11 November 2026.
M&C Precision filed a writ of summons, disclosed as material litigation.
Substantial shareholder Accrelist Crowdfunding disposed of 30 million shares (12.184%) off-market on 20 October 2026.
risks_en: The private placement of new shares representing up to 10% of issued shares may dilute existing shareholders.
The company faces litigation filed by M&C Precision.
A substantial shareholder disposed of a large block of shares off-market.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 20.117 million, up 8.9% QoQ and 14.2% YoY; net income was MYR 3.859 million, up 21.1% QoQ and 36.3% YoY; net margin was 19.2%, higher than 17.3% in the previous quarter.
